This scenario involves a person adjusting the thermostat to a higher temperature because their mother-in-law experiences hot flashes. Hot flashes cause sudden feelings of warmth, often leading to discomfort in warm environments. Turning up the thermostat would likely make her more uncomfortable, not less. The action described seems counterproductive and would worsen her discomfort rather than help. Therefore, it is not morally acceptable to intentionally cause harm or discomfort.
